# samples: github.com/haskell/haskell-language-server/2026-10-26/40258645053-121365918403-build-x86_64-linux-deb11-9124--failure.log.gz
# 锚: apt/apt-get (Debian 系包管理器) 安装中止判词行 `E: Unable to fetch some archives,
# maybe run apt-get update or try with --fix-missing?` — apt 在归档获取失败放弃安装时
# 必打的收尾错误行 (工具签名), 任何仓的 deb 系容器 CI 均可出现, 非仓特有守卫文案。
# 取舍: 同一失败 run 内的 `E: Failed to fetch <url> 404 ...` 逐包行 (本样本 20+ 行)
# 刻意不锚不扩展 — 多行吞入有压缩率双测退化前科 (见 python-logging-critical-message
# 的取舍记录: phpstan ERROR 级行因逐行提取致 >2% 退化而退役); 单行判词即完整失败
# 证据 (获取失败 → 安装中止), 成功侧 FP 面极窄 (仅 wrapper 重试恢复场景同构)。
# 根因族: 镜像 404 (deb11 EOL 池轮换) / 网络超时 — 均为依赖获取失败, category deps。
# 扩展 (DG batch3): ① `E: Failed to fetch <url> <code> ...` 逐包行 (libuv: 403
#   Forbidden + no longer signed, 单行亦完整证据); ② apt 锁失败双行 `E: Could not
#   open lock file /var/lib/apt/lists/lock - open (13: Permission denied)` /
#   `E: Unable to lock directory ...` (shellcheck: 并发 apt 冲突)。FP 扫描全语料
#   5 failure / 0 success。
id: apt-fetch-failed
title: 'apt 包获取/锁失败 (E: Unable to fetch|Failed to fetch|lock file)'
tool: apt
category: deps
intent: failure
confidence: high
patterns:
  - regex: '^(?:[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?E: (Unable to fetch some archives|Failed to fetch |Could not open lock file |Unable to lock directory)'
kind: signal
attribution:
  contributor: 'LuoChen <2309868+luochen1990@users.noreply.github.com> (agent-drafted, fn-responder/glm-5.3)'
  generated-by: {harness: fn-responder, model: glm-5.3}
  adapter-version: 0.1.0

# samples: protocolbuffers/protobuf/39550723836-119059086397
# bazel 经典错误头: 行首 `ERROR: ` 前缀的两类高特异形态 —
# ① `ERROR: <path>:<row>:<col>: <msg>` (规则/目标求值失败, 如 repository fetch 失败的 Traceback 头);
# ② `ERROR: no such (package|target|rule|label)` (external 仓库解析失败)。
# 锚刻意收紧到这两形态而非裸 `ERROR: ` — pip 的 `ERROR: pip's dependency resolver ...`
# 依赖冲突警告在成功 job 常见 (fmtlib 39574123266 实测), 裸前缀会误吸。
# ext loop: 3 空格/tab 缩进续行 (Starlark `   Traceback` / `\tFile "...", line N` / `\t\tdownload_info = ...`),
# `Error in download: ...` 无缩进根因行不被吞 (ERROR 锚行自身即签名, 根因行紧邻下一个块或闭块边界)。
id: bazel-error
title: 'bazel 错误头 (ERROR: path:row:col / ERROR: no such ...) + Starlark Traceback 缩进树'
tool: bazel
category: build
confidence: high
patterns:
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(ERROR: \S+:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: |ERROR: no such (package|target|rule|label)[ :])'
  - regex: '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z )?(   |\t)\S'
    loop: true
kind: signal
attribution:
  contributor: luochen1990
  generated-by: {harness: opencode-agent, model: glm-5.3}
  adapter-version: 0.1.0
